items.difficulty_reason: Pushforward analogue j_{U,*}/j_{V,*}: part (1) claims exactness of the section sequence on arbitrary W, reduces to W = X using lemma-make-more-elementary-distinguished-squares, derives the sequence by applying the right-exact Hom(-, F) to the lower-shriek sequence of lemma-exact-sequence-lower-shriek, and kills the lifting obstruction via Ext^1(O_X, F) = H^1(X, F) plus locality of cohomology (etale-local vanishing); part (2) assembles the derived triangle from K-injective complexes with injective terms.
